message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/devel/fuzz/gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":26,"var":"data/size","code":"gnutls_datum_t raw = {(unsigned char*)data, (unsigned int)size};","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes from the fuzz input are wrapped into a PKCS#12 datum and passed into the parser."},
{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/devel/fuzz/gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":35,"var":"p12","code":"ret = gnutls_pkcs12_import(p12, &raw, GNUTLS_X509_FMT_DER, 0);","note":"The raw input is parsed as a PKCS#12 structure, creating internal bags and objects that later drive the vulnerable path."},
{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1450,"var":"bag","code":"ret = gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag(p12, idx, bag);","note":"The parser iterates over PKCS#12 bags and reaches attacker-controlled bag contents, including CRL bags."},
{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1578,"var":"*crl","code":"ret = gnutls_x509_crl_init(crl);","note":"When a CRL bag is encountered, the function allocates and stores a CRL object in the caller-provided output pointer."},
{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1584,"var":"*crl->der","code":"ret = gnutls_x509_crl_import(*crl, &data, GNUTLS_X509_FMT_DER);","note":"The CRL bag data is imported into the newly allocated CRL object, populating its internal DER buffer and ASN.1 state."},
{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1745,"var":"*crl","code":"gnutls_x509_crl_deinit(*crl);","note":"On a later parse failure, the cleanup path frees the CRL object but leaves the caller's crl variable pointing to freed memory until the caller checks the return value."},
{"step":7,"file":"src-vul/gnutls/devel/fuzz/gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":52,"var":"crl","code":"if (ret >= 0) { ... if (crl) gnutls_x509_crl_deinit(crl); }","note":"The fuzzer only deinitializes the CRL on success, so a malformed PKCS#12 that triggers the cleanup bug can leave a dangling CRL path that is later exercised by the target's internal deinit logic, producing the use-after-free crash."}
]
pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('wrote trace')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gnutls/devel/fuzz/gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.cc /workspace/candidate_trace.json
